review: All 52 active originals inspected at full size for verse/setting/action, visible faces, ages, relationships, hands/fingers/thumbs/limbs and animals. Seven final versioned replacements inspected as generated PNG and final encoded WebP beside approved references/nearby scenes. Small background faces and occluded digits are bounded by resolution.

Moses.stableTraits: Lined medium-brown long face, prominent long nose, natural gray curls, long gray-white beard, lean weathered build. Age80 at Exodus7:7; no generational aging into Leviticus.
Moses.result: Corrected 9:23 and 24:10 faces and maintained ordination likeness. Other camp speakers remain compatible at visible angles. Reverse-view chapter20 opener retains curls/build without inventing facial certainty.

Aaron.stableTraits: Medium-brown rounder lined face, strong nose, natural gray curls, full gray beard, compact build compared with Moses. Age83 at Exodus7:7, no extra aging into Leviticus.
Aaron.result: Corrected drifting high-priest likenesses. Retained gray-bearded covered-hair 5:7 portrait as compatible. Both hands rest on live goat; 16:4 white-linen clothing is distinct from ceremonial blue/gold vestments. Illustrative unnamed priests in other legal scenes are not all assigned Aaron’s name.

Aaron_sons_and_priests.stableTraits: Adult brown-complexioned men with natural dark curls, full dark beards, adult builds and white linen. Some faces appear in partial/cropped groups; no unsupported mapping of every face to a name.
Aaron_sons_and_priests.result: Retained individually recognizable sons from ordination original during both edits. Compared the two incense-bearers in chapter10 beside Exodus29 and ordination group: compatible adult natural curls/brown faces/beards/builds. The pair is identifiable collectively as Nadab/Abihu; which face has which name is unestablished, not guessed. Legal-law chapter21 group is a representative priestly group, not a claimed family portrait of four surviving sons. Future named Eleazar/Ithamar scenes need unambiguous anchors; do not identify anonymous helpers from these illustrations.

Recurring_households.result: Compared repeated two-child family/camp/feast/settled-law motifs for brown complexion, natural curls, adult builds, children’s relative ages and roles. Compatible illustrative households, never assigned Moses/Aaron family identities. Childbirth edit retains the same mother, infant and companion. Long-term settled-land applications are illustrations of the laws, not claims that Moses has moved into Canaan.
